summary: F1: Impossible travel from Amsterdam to Manisa in 180 minutes indicates anomalous access. F2: 20 sign-ins from DigitalOcean NL (AS14061) outside account baseline. F3: 9 sign-ins from Hetzner DE (AS24940) outside account baseline. All findings suggest valid account abuse via cloud infrastructure.

risk.rationale: Verified findings show a confirmed account takeover chain: multiple suspicious sign-ins from cloud-provider ASNs outside the account baseline (DigitalOcean NL, 20 events; Hetzner DE, 9 events) plus confirmed impossible travel (Amsterdam → Manisa in 180 min). All findings are CONFIRMED with no rejected claims or data-quality conflicts. The combination of attacker-style infrastructure logins and geographic impossibility indicates active compromise rather than a weak or explained signal, warranting containment.
